quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: MHI Thermal Systems Launches "ETI-W" Series Heat Recovery (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Group company Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Thermal Systems is expanding sales of its ETI-W heat-recovery water-to-water centrifugal heat pump, launched in Japan in 2025, to overseas markets from October 2026. The unit reuses low-temperature waste heat to supply hot water up to 90 degrees C, with a maximum heating capacity of 640kW and a heating COP of 4.01 even when supplying 90 degree C water, using the low-GWP refrigerant HFO-1233zd(E). Overseas focus: process applications in electronics, automotive, food, chemical and pharmaceutical factories, and heating / hot water for commercial and accommodation facilities, sold and serviced through the centrifugal-chiller sales and service network; the company says facilities such as data centers that continuously generate waste heat from cooling equipment can, under suitable conditions, use it as a heat source.
quarterly_data.figure: hot water up to 90 degrees C; maximum heating capacity 640kW; COP 4.01; overseas sales from October 2026
